description: This file defines the XSeries class, which represents a series of data points on the X-Axis in a charting context within the PDFsharp library. It provides methods for adding, cloning, and enumerating x-values.

classes.name: XSeries
classes.description: Represents a series of data points on the X-Axis in a chart, with methods for managing values and cloning.

methods.name: this[int]
methods.description: Indexer to get the x-value at the specified index.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the XSeries object.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Implements deep copying logic for the object, including its elements collection.

methods.name: AddBlank
methods.description: Adds a blank data point to the series.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a string value as a data point to the series.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds multiple string values as data points to the series.

methods.name: GetEnumerator
methods.description: Returns an enumerator for iterating over the series elements.
